macros.name: Graphic
macros.doc: The purpose of the \Graphic tag is to display graphical output.

macros.name: SRcaptioncontinuedfont
macros.doc: \SRcaptioncontinuedfont specifies the font for the continued name for outputs that break across pages.

macros.name: SRcaptionfont
macros.doc: \SRcaptionfont specifies the font for the output captions.

macros.name: SRcontinuedname
macros.doc: \SRcontinuedname specifies the name that indicates that an output block is continued.

macros.name: SRdefaultdests
macros.doc: \SRdefaultdests specifies the default ODS Destination for tabular outputs.

macros.name: SRdpi
macros.doc: \SRdpi specifies the default dots per inch (DPI) for SAS to use in generating graphical output.

macros.name: SRgraphicdir
macros.doc: \SRgraphicdir specifies the name of the directory that contains the SAS generated graphical output files.

macros.name: SRgraphtype
macros.doc: \SRgraphtype specifies the format of the SAS generated graphical output.

macros.name: SRintertext
macros.doc: \SRintertext specifies the text to insert in Datastep environments that specify the first= option.

macros.name: SRlatexdir
macros.doc: \SRlatexdir specifies the name of the directory that contains the SAS generated LaTeX tabular output.

macros.name: SRlatexstyle
macros.doc: \SRlatexstyle specifies the ODS style for SAS to use to generate LaTeX tabular output.

macros.name: SRlinesize
macros.doc: \SRlinesize specifies the default line size to use in generating tabular output and centering it for display.

macros.name: SRlistingdir
macros.doc: \SRlistingdir specifies the name of the directory that contains the SAS generated listing (tabular) output files.

macros.name: SRmacroinclude
macros.doc: \SRmacroinclude specifies the line used in the generated SAS program to include the SAS macros that are bundled with the StatRep package.

macros.name: SRmacropath
macros.doc: \SRmacropath specifies the path to the location of the SAS macros that are bundled with the StatRep package.

macros.name: SRpagesize
macros.doc: \SRpagesize specifies the default page size for SAS to use in generating tabular output.

macros.name: SRparindent
macros.doc: \SRparindent specifies the amount of space to indent Datastep and Sascode environments.

macros.name: SRprogramname
macros.doc: \SRprogramname specifies the filename for the generated SAS program.

macros.name: SRstyle
macros.doc: \SRstyle specifies the default ODS style for SAS to use to generate graphical output.

macros.name: SRtempfilename
macros.doc: \SRtempfilename specifies the name of a temporary file that is used as a scratch file in the current working directory.

macros.name: SRverbfont
macros.doc: \SRverbfont specifies the font to use for code within Datastep and Sascode blocks.

macros.name: unsloppy
macros.doc: The \unsloppy macro is called when the stream insertion is finished to undo the effects of a \dosloppy command, which is called when the width of the output is greater than the width of the textblock.

envs.name: Datastep
envs.doc: The purpose of the Datastep environment is to read in data.

envs.name: Sascode
envs.doc: The purpose of the Sascode environment is to generate output.
